question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Zealous
solution:
The correct answer is "**enthusiastic.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Zealous** means having great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause or an objective. (किसी कारण या उद्देश्य की प्राप्ति के लिए अत्यधिक ऊर्जा या उत्साह होना)

 
 
• Example: She was zealous about her job and worked tirelessly to achieve her goals.
 
 
 
• **Enthusiastic **means having or showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval. (तीव्र और उत्सुक आनंद, रुचि होना या दिखाना)
 
 
• Example: He is very enthusiastic about his work.
 
 
 
 
 
• Synonyms of Zealous include enthusiastic, passionate, fervent, ardent, and eager.
 
• **Thus, it can be concluded that the word "enthusiastic" is a synonym of the word "zealous."**

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: **Detached** means aloof and objective, not influenced by personal feelings or interests. (अलग और उद्देश्यपूर्ण, व्यक्तिगत भावनाओं या रुचियों से प्रभावित नहीं)
 
• Option 3: **Apathetic** means showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern. (कोई रुचि, उत्साह या चिंता न दिखाना या महसूस करना)
 
• Option 4: **Indifferent** means having no particular interest or sympathy, unconcerned. (कोई विशेष रुचि या सहानुभूति न रखते हुए, बेपरवाह)
